scripts.extensions: mkdir -p generated/extensions/v1.5.4/wasm_eh && for e in icu json; do [ -f generated/extensions/v1.5.4/wasm_eh/$e.duckdb_extension.wasm ] || curl -fsS -o generated/extensions/v1.5.4/wasm_eh/$e.duckdb_extension.wasm https://extensions.duckdb.org/v1.5.4/wasm_eh/$e.duckdb_extension.wasm || exit 1; done
scripts.dev: bun run wasm && bun run extensions && rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp -r showcase dist/showcase && cp -r generated/extensions dist/extensions && bun build ./index.html --outdir dist --watch
scripts.build: bun run wasm && bun run extensions && rm -rf dist && bun build ./index.html --production --outdir dist && cp -r showcase dist/showcase && cp -r generated/extensions dist/extensions
scripts.site: bun run build && rm -rf ../site && mkdir ../site && cp ../../landing/index.html ../../landing/*.png ../site/ && cp -r dist ../site/app && cp _headers ../site/_headers
